theory.intro: Intermediate Track Final Review & Assessment is a core security discipline in AWS cloud operations.

sections.heading: Understanding Intermediate Track Final Review & Assessment
sections.content: In modern cloud environments, proper configuration of Intermediate Track Final Review & Assessment ensures privilege boundaries and access controls prevent unauthorized resource manipulation.

sections.heading: Security Risks & Attack Vectors
sections.content: Misconfigurations related to Intermediate Track Final Review & Assessment allow attackers to perform unauthorized reconnaissance, privilege escalation, and persistent access within your cloud tenant.

sections.heading: Defense & Mitigation Strategies
sections.content: Enforce strict principle of least privilege, continuous auditing via CloudTrail/Config, and automated guardrails.

key_terms.definition: Granting only minimum permissions required to perform job functions.
AWS auditing service tracking API activity across account resources.
Capturing and analyzing event logs for incident detection and forensics.

question.explanation: Misconfiguring Intermediate Track Final Review & Assessment directly breaches privilege boundaries, allowing attackers to access unauthorized resources.

question.text: Which security framework principle best prevents cloud misconfigurations?
question.explanation: The Principle of Least Privilege ensures identities are restricted to minimum required permissions.
